indicator_name: Survey of other financial organisations (quarterly, from 2015)
description: Обзор других финансовых организаций (квартальный, с 2015 г.)
unit: million KZT, stock at the end of the previous quarter (as at the date)
methodology: NBK page «Обзор других финансовых организаций» (records JSON), quarter-end stocks from 2015-Q1 dated the first day of the next quarter (2015-04-01 … 2026-07-01), as form 26. Coverage: Development Bank of Kazakhstan, mortgage companies, insurers, pension funds (NBK methodology /file/download/87908) -- claims mix DBK lending with UAPF and insurers' bond holdings. Quasi-fiscal lines: OFC.r_o_s_r_s_nf_o claims on public nonfinancial organisations (438 758 mln at 2015-04-01, 966 553 at 2022-01-01, 1 968 351 at 2026-07-01; = IMF MFS_OFC S12R_A_ACO_S11001_OFCS), OFC.r_o_s_r_ng_nf_o on non-state ones (858 531, 2 201 762, 2 921 591), OFC.c loans received. n_e_a, n_e_a_r_nr and r_b_s equal the form 26 scalars OFC_NET_FOREIGN_ASSETS / OFC_CLAIMS_ON_NONRESIDENTS / OFC_CLAIMS_ON_BANKING_SYSTEM on the 15 common dates within 0.5 mln (enforced). No OFC survey exists before 2015 (NBK or IMF).
